response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial contributions via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust experience in routing, navigation, or distributed data pipelines — key requirements for the role. His DLang and Node.js background shows systems programming aptitude, but the absence of proven work with routing tiles, map optimization, or real-time traffic integration raises significant gaps.
strengths: Built open-source geospatial platform (GISCollective) with real-world NGO usage
Demonstrated systems-level programming with DLang, asynchronous I/O, and low-latency systems
Strong track record of learning new technologies and contributing across full stack
concerns: No explicit C++ or Rust experience in commercial routing or geospatial data pipelines
Lack of demonstrated expertise in distributed systems for routing tile consistency or fault tolerance
Primary recent work is in TypeScript/Node.js, not the core C++ stack required for this role
